The fix is complete in `packages/docusaurus/src/server/brokenLinks.ts`:

**Root cause:** `isAnchorBrokenLink` looked up the anchor target page in `collectedLinks` using only the exact pathname from the link. Pages are collected under their SSG pathname (e.g. `/docs/test/` with `trailingSlash: true`), so a link like `/docs/test#abc` (no trailing slash) failed the lookup and was falsely reported as a broken anchor — even though the path itself was already validated via non-strict route matching in `isPathBrokenLink`.

**Fix:** Added `BrokenLinksHelper.getPossiblePathnames()` which generates all trailing-slash/URL-encoding variants of the link pathname, and used it for both the `collectedLinks` target-page lookup and the `knownPage` valid-pathname check. Since the anchor check only runs after the path check passes, strict-route semantics are unaffected.
